description: Configuration for one local-openfinance report topic. The topic id is inferred from the config filename. Each file defines local SQLite storage, sync behavior, annotation helpers, shared report filters, and model settings.

storage.description: Filesystem location for the local Open Finance SQLite database populated by sync.

databasePath.description: Path to the local SQLite database populated by sync. When omitted, defaults to openfinance.sqlite beside the config file.

sync.description: Optional rules controlling how the sync command talks to Banco MCP before reading local data.

forceBeforeFetch.description: When true, call openfinance_force_sync for configured connections before incremental fetch.

forceUpsert.description: When true, re-fetch and upsert all rows: skip no known ids, paginate full transaction and investment-transaction history, and refresh categories. Investments, accounts, loans, and bills always upsert.

connections.description: Optional list of connection selectors (item_id, connector_id, or connector_name). When omitted, sync all connected banks returned by openfinance_list_connections.

items.description: One Banco MCP connection selector passed to list/sync endpoints.

lookbackDays.description: Number of calendar days to overlap when resuming transaction fetch per account. Defaults to 7 when omitted.

pageSize.description: Default page size for paginated Open Finance list endpoints. Defaults to 100 when omitted.

annotation.description: Optional embedding and classifier helpers used by the classify command to suggest categories for new entries.

embedding.description: Embedding model settings for similarity search against manually classified entries.

classifier.description: Optional classifier model that ranks candidate categories before the interactive wizard.

similarityThreshold.description: Minimum cosine similarity (0-1) required to surface an embedding suggestion. Defaults to 0.82 when omitted.

pushCategoriesUpstream.description: Ignored. Local classifications stay in SQLite and are not sent to Banco MCP.

report.description: Shared filters for named reports. Each named report will define its own prompts.

accountIds.description: Optional account uuid allow-list. When omitted, all synced accounts are eligible.

includeUnannotated.description: When false, only entries with a local annotation are sent to the model. Defaults to true when omitted.

reports.description: Ordered named reports. Each report owns its schedule, window, prompts, and optional filter or model overrides.

web.description: Optional local web UI settings used when serving the app and when rendering links in reports.

publicBaseUrl.description: Public origin for permalinks in emails and reports, such as a Tailscale Service URL. Do not include an access token. When omitted, links are hash-only.

intelligence.description: Optional thresholds for weekly intelligence briefings and report item filtering.

suggestionConfidenceThreshold.description: Minimum score required to use a pending classification suggestion in report analysis. Defaults to 0.82 when omitted.

minReportedItemAmountCents.description: Absolute amount in cents below which individual transactions are omitted from report prose and item lists. Totals and charts still include them. Defaults to 10000 (R$100.00).

rareLookbackYears.description: How many years of history to search when matching rare large events. Defaults to 3.

chatModel.description: Optional live-chat model. When omitted, the web chat uses `model`.

notify.description: Optional outbound notification settings for report email and explicit sync suggestion digests.

smtp.description: SMTP delivery for report email and explicit sync suggestion digests. Password is read from the environment variable named by auth.passEnvVar.

port.description: SMTP port. Defaults to 587 when omitted.

secure.description: When true, use TLS from connection start. When false, require a STARTTLS upgrade before authentication or delivery. Defaults to false.

to.description: Recipient email address or list of addresses.

oneOf.description: One or more recipient email addresses.

auth.description: Optional SMTP authentication. The password is never stored in the config file.

passEnvVar.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the SMTP password.

model.description: LLM provider and generation settings used for report analysis. Live chat uses chatModel when set, otherwise this model.

window.description: Local date window for the report.

prompts.description: Ordered prompt references resolved relative to the config.

language.description: Supported locale used for report text, translations, dates, numbers, and charts. Defaults to pt-BR when omitted.

agentBudget.description: Limits report-agent steps. Defaults are 8 analyst steps, 4 reviewer steps per round, and 2 reviewer rounds.

day.description: Local calendar day 1-28 or the last day of the month.

oneOf.description: A fixed local calendar day from 1 through 28.
The last local calendar day of the month.

analysisModel.description: LLM provider and generation settings used for report analysis or live chat.

provider.description: Built-in AI SDK provider id such as openai, anthropic, google, xai, openrouter, opencode, openai-compatible, gateway, or ollama.

model.description: Provider-specific model name passed to the Vercel AI SDK provider factory.

baseUrl.description: Optional provider base URL for analysis model providers that support custom endpoints, such as openai-compatible and ollama.

temperature.description: Optional model sampling temperature. Omitted automatically for known reasoning model families.

maxOutputTokens.description: Optional upper bound for generated output tokens.

reasoningEffort.description: OpenAI reasoning effort. Valid only when provider is openai.

pricing.description: USD per million tokens captured with generated usage.

scoringModel.description: Embedding or classifier model configuration for annotation helpers.

provider.description: Built-in scoring helper provider id such as ollama, openai, openrouter, google, gateway, or openai-compatible.

model.description: Provider-specific model name used for embeddings or classification.

baseUrl.description: Optional provider base URL for scoring helpers that support custom endpoints.

pricing.description: USD per million tokens captured with embedding usage.

reportAgentBudget.description: Limits for report analyst and reviewer model-call loops. A taxonomy-policy cache miss may add one provider call outside these loops.

reviewerMaxSteps.description: Maximum model steps in each reviewer round.

modelPricing.description: Token rates in US dollars per million tokens.

input.description: Input-token rate in US dollars per million tokens.

cachedInput.description: Cached-input-token rate in US dollars per million tokens.

output.description: Output-token rate in US dollars per million tokens.
